step1_labelDrift.verdict: CAUSE IS NOT THE LABEL SLOT. The resting label is 8px low because the Label / resting frame is absolutely positioned at y 16 inside the 40-tall small input, the inset that centres a 24-tall label in the 56-tall medium input ((56-24)/2 = 16); the small inset should be 8 ((40-24)/2). The 56-tall Label slot (flag npveProblemsBuild_textFieldSmallLabelSlotHeight) is a separate defect in the outline part and does not move the label. Reported, not reconciled: the label-slot flag stays at low with a cross-reference; the drift gets its own DEFECT flag at medium because it is plainly visible at 1x in the library file itself.
